sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has furnished copy of the paper book which is taken on record.
She contends that the adulterated khoya is stated to have been recovered from the petitioner on 21.08.1980 which was found to be containing milk fat below the minimum prescribed standard.
The sample indicated 18.4% milk fat against the minimum standard of 20%.
The petitioner had been convicted and sentenced under Section 16/7 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of six months.
Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that she had sent a letter to the petitioner which was received back with the remarks that the petitioner has expired.
She has handed over the envelope with the aforenoted endorsement which is taken on record.
In view of the above, the petition stands disposed of as abated.

29.05.2019 (ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL)
